item.title: Goodbye Claude, Hello Pi
item.description:
📝 I’ve been a longtime Claude Code user, ever since it became available in the Claude Pro subscription plan over a year ago. md thing kind of epitomizes the whole reason I decided to quit using Claude Code. Despite chopping 80% of the system prompt, Claude Code still has way more overhead than Pi for seemingly no benefit.

item.title: Cancer at Sea
item.description:
📝 Research assistant Barbie Halaska prepares a California sea lion pup carcass for a necropsy at The Marine Mammal Center. The Marine Mammal Center shares tissue samples with researchers from around the world. The center took in 1,800 animals last year, 1,300 of which were California sea lions.
🔗 Read more: https://biographic.com/cancer-at-sea/
